section: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. The workspace remains available until that period ends, and cancellation prevents the next renewal. A confirmation email states the effective date so that the team can plan its transition. A customer can therefore cancel future billing while continuing to use time that has already been purchased. Cancellation is not the same operation as deleting a workspace, and staff should not present those actions as interchangeable.
